hooks.name: Go vet, fmt check, build and test on save
hooks.description: On saving a backend Go file, check formatting then run go vet, build, and the test suite scoped to the backend packages.

action.command: gofmt -l cmd internal | (grep -q . && { echo 'gofmt needed:'; gofmt -l cmd internal; exit 1; } || true) && go vet ./cmd/... ./internal/... && go build ./cmd/... ./internal/... && go test ./cmd/... ./internal/...
